[4:56PM] #Apapa_Ajegunle #TrafficUpdate 

Motorists can expect a fast-moving commute from both Ojo Road and Otto Wharf to Ajeromi. At Ajeromi Junction, all commercial buses are currently being diverted to Ojora Way to connect to Boundary Bus Stop.

Movement from Baale Street to the Boundary Roundabout is also progressing well. Furthermore, the stretch of Mobil Road, both inward and outward, is experiencing fast-moving vehicle traffic at this time.

From High Bridge/Ijora Oloopa Ramp to Total, traffic is flowing quickly on both lanes. However, shortly after Total by the RRS Junction, one lane is occupied by trucks, while the second lane remains clear for cars and other vehicles.

Lastly, vehicles exiting Apapa Front Point Road through the Marine Bridge to Iganmu are also encountering fast-moving traffic. No impediments have been recorded as of this hour, and officers are on ground ensuring smooth traffic flow.

#FollowLASTMA

[6:09PM] #Vi #TrafficUpdate 

The current traffic situation in V.i indicates a steady movement of vehicles towards McWen Bridge.
However, a notable backlog has developed, extending to Ahmadu Bello Way and Ozumba Mbadiwe via Bonny Camp Roundabout, primarily due to the peak hour rush and traffic alternation.

Fortunately, no impediments have been reported at this time, and our dedicated officers are actively managing the situation on ground to ensure a smooth and uninterrupted flow of traffic.

[6:11PM] #Marina #TrafficUpdate 

Smooth traffic flow from UBA Roundabout to NNPC Filling Station and from Cathedral Church to Nitel Intersection.
Good movement observed from State House to Mcwen Bridge and connecting Force Road.
Fast-moving traffic reported from Zone 2 Underneath Bridge to Flagstaff House and inward towards Mekwen Bridge.
Favorable traffic conditions on the stretch from Onikan Roundabout to TBS and inward towards Water Board, connecting Nitel Intersection.
Unimpeded movement along the entire Broad Street axis, including from General Hospital to Tinubu Square and connecting Abibu Oki Street via Martins Junction.
Slow and steady traffic approaching Davies Street due to commercial activities.
Efficient movement on Igbosere Road and Catholic Mission Street, connecting Ganiu Smith Street.

Officers are actively managing the situation to maintain a smooth flow of traffic.

data.text:
[7:30PM] #Idumota #TrafficUpdate 

High traffic volume on the route from Oyebanji Roundabout to Adeniji Adele Road via Oba's Palace and Police Post, attributed to ongoing construction work in the area.
Busy traffic conditions on the stretch from Tinubu Square to Nnamdi Azikiwe Street, en route to Tom Jones Intersection, largely due to market activities.
Slow movement under the Idumota Bridge, particularly on the inward journey from Eyin Eyo to Balogun and Martin Streets, resulting from bus stop activities along the corridor.
Smooth traffic flow on Ilubinrin connecting Carter Bridge, inward towards Ijora Olopa, as well as Oyingbo, with vehicles moving at a relatively faster pace.

Officers remain actively engaged in managing the traffic flow to mitigate congestion.
